title: gaph_v2 pipeline parameters
description: GAPH v2 gene fetch and ortholog-to-target alignment workflow

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

stage.description: Pipeline stage to run. 'all' runs fetch, alignment, and annotation; 'align' runs alignment only from an existing fetch directory.

ids_file.description: Path to the input file containing gene IDs

fetch_dir.description: Directory containing fetched sequences and target context. Required if stage is 'align' or 'annotate'.

events_tsv.description: Path to events TSV for annotation stage

event_ortholog_support_tsv.description: Path to the event_group_id-keyed event_ortholog_support.tsv.gz companion required with alignment_events.tsv.gz for standalone annotation.

segments_tsv.description: Path to alignment segments TSV for annotation-stage site depth

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

alignment_strategies.description: Comma-separated alignment strategies to run, or 'all' for the default-enabled strategy set. The precomputed Ensembl strategy is explicit opt-in.

clinvar_vcf.description: Path to ClinVar VCF file for annotation. Defaults to CLINVAR_VCF, then assets/reference/clinvar/clinvar.vcf.gz when present. ClinVar is required for annotation.

gnomad_cache_dir.description: Optional shared gnomAD regional cache directory. Defaults to GAPH_GNOMAD_CACHE_DIR, then $GAPH_ROOT/cache/gnomad when GAPH_ROOT is set.

chunk_size.description: Number of genes to process per chunk

target_annotation_gff3.description: Local NCBI RefSeq GFF3 for the target assembly. Defaults to GAPH_TARGET_ANNOTATION_GFF3, then assets/reference/ncbi/refseq/GCF_000001405.40_GRCh38.p14/genomic.gff.gz.

alignment_max_forks.description: Maximum concurrent tasks in each aligner process. The two minimap2 presets share one process and one limit; nucmer and BWA each have their own process. Total alignment concurrency is also bounded by executor CPU/queue limits.

alignment_partition_size.description: Maximum target genes per bounded alignment and annotation output partition.

annotation_max_forks.description: Maximum concurrent annotation partition tasks. Each task receives size-aware memory from its ortholog-support row count and also performs bounded parallel gnomAD requests.

ensembl_compara_maf_manifest.description: Optional release-116 92-mammals EPO Extended chunk manifest. Defaults to ENSEMBL_COMPARA_MAF_MANIFEST, then the matching asset path; otherwise it is built during the run.
